name: com.classicalbot/concerts
title: ClassicalBot
description: Upcoming classical concerts worldwide: opera, recitals, orchestral, chamber and soundtrack concerts.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Resolve names to ClassicalBot IDs before searching concerts. Look up one name per call: for "Mahler in Vienna", look up "Mahler" with kinds ["composer"] and "Vienna" with kinds ["city"]. Matching ignores case and accents; every result shows its number of upcoming concerts, so prefer the well-performed namesake. Works match every word against title, catalogue number and composer: "mahler symphony 2", "bwv 244".

query.description: A name: composer, work title or catalogue number, soundtrack, performer, venue or city.

kinds.description: What to search; default all six.

country_code.description: Restrict venues and cities to this country.

tools.name: search_concerts
tools.description: Upcoming classical concerts worldwide, soonest first, matching every filter given (at least one). IDs come from lookup; several IDs in one filter match any. Returns a compact listing; call get_concert for full details of one. For "how many" or "where most" questions use summarize_concerts instead of paging.

composer_ids.description: Composer IDs from lookup. Includes concerts programming any of their works. Matches any of them.

work_ids.description: Work IDs from lookup. Matches any of them.

soundtrack_ids.description: Film, TV or game soundtrack IDs from lookup. Matches any of them.

include_featuring.description: With soundtrack_ids, also return mixed programmes that play only some of the music. By default only concerts devoted to the title are returned.

performer_ids.description: Performer IDs (people or ensembles) from lookup. Matches any of them.

venue_ids.description: Venue IDs from lookup. Matches any of them.

city_ids.description: City IDs from lookup. Matches any of them.

near.description: A point; returns concerts in cities within radius_km of it. Cannot be combined with city_ids or country_code.

date_from.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Concerts are always today or later.

text.description: Words that must all appear in the title, venue, city, composers or works (as listed, e.g. "resurrection"). Fuzzier and slower than IDs: prefer lookup first.

source_url.description: An organisation's website, such as an orchestra, opera house or festival: only concerts published there. A website ClassicalBot does not know yet is queued for crawling, and its concerts appear later.

tools.name: get_concert
tools.description: Full details of one upcoming concert by the id from search_concerts: complete programme, every performer with roles, every price with who it is for (discounts included), ticket and event links, booking status and the organiser's description, with the ID of every composer, work, performer and soundtrack on the item itself, and of its city and venue under ids, for further searches.

tools.name: summarize_concerts
tools.description: Takes the same filters as search_concerts (at least one) and counts the matching upcoming concerts per group, largest first (months in calendar order). Answers "where is Bruckner played most?", "which Mahler symphonies are on in Vienna this spring?", "how many Zelda concerts per month?". Group keys are IDs usable in search_concerts filters, ISO country codes, or YYYY-MM months. A concert with two composers counts in both groups; total counts each concert once.

composer_ids.description: Composer IDs from lookup. Includes concerts programming any of their works. Matches any of them.

work_ids.description: Work IDs from lookup. Matches any of them.

soundtrack_ids.description: Film, TV or game soundtrack IDs from lookup. Matches any of them.

include_featuring.description: With soundtrack_ids, also return mixed programmes that play only some of the music. By default only concerts devoted to the title are returned.

performer_ids.description: Performer IDs (people or ensembles) from lookup. Matches any of them.

venue_ids.description: Venue IDs from lookup. Matches any of them.

city_ids.description: City IDs from lookup. Matches any of them.

near.description: A point; returns concerts in cities within radius_km of it. Cannot be combined with city_ids or country_code.

date_from.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Concerts are always today or later.

text.description: Words that must all appear in the title, venue, city, composers or works (as listed, e.g. "resurrection"). Fuzzier and slower than IDs: prefer lookup first.

source_url.description: An organisation's website ClassicalBot already crawls: only concerts published there. An unknown website returns an error; pass it to search_concerts instead, which queues new websites for crawling.

tools.name: get_details
tools.description: One composer, work or soundtrack by ID: its upcoming concert count, the ten countries where it is played most (for a soundtrack, dedicated concerts; featuring_countries adds mixed programmes) and its classicalbot.com page; for a composer also the twenty most performed works (with IDs for search_concerts).
